title: Login with Amazon Documentation
summary: Login with Amazon uses OAuth 2.0 for user-authorized access. It has integration guides for websites, mobile apps, and devices. Devices without a browser can use code-based linking: display a code and verification URL, then the user signs in on another device.

title: Register for Login with Amazon
summary: Website integration starts with a Security Profile in the Developer Console. Configure HTTPS Allowed Origins for the JavaScript SDK popup flow or Allowed Return URLs for redirect-based authorization. Supply a privacy-policy URL for the consent experience.

title: Refresh Tokens
summary: A refresh token obtains another access token after the original expires. It belongs to one client and cannot be used by another. Refresh tokens are returned through the Authorization Code Grant. Revoked app access invalidates their use.

title: In-App Purchasing Overview
summary: The Appstore SDK IAP API supports purchases of digital items and subscriptions in Android apps. Amazon manages the purchase flow and payment handling. The application must implement fulfillment. Each purchasable item has a unique SKU configured in the Developer Console.

title: IAP Testing Overview
summary: App Tester provides sandbox responses for IAP calls. RVS has separate sandbox and production environments. DevTest supports local end-to-end IAP testing without uploading a binary. Live App Testing uses a limited tester group in the production environment; testers are not charged for purchases.

title: App Submission API for Testing
summary: This REST API registers an application for Appstore DevTest and adds testers. Requests include an OAuth session token in the HTTP header. Registration requires the package name and signing certificate. Separate operations register the application and add testers.

title: Submit Your App to the Amazon Appstore
summary: Prepare the app binary, developer account, listing assets, descriptions, and a physical test device. Fire OS supports APK or AAB; Vega OS uses VPKG. A Vega manifest needs the main category. Complete upload, targeting, store details, and review before submission.

title: App Bundles
summary: Amazon Appstore accepts Android App Bundles and generates device-optimized APKs. APK submission remains an option. Test bundles locally with bundletool and then with Live App Testing. Non-install-time asset delivery is not supported by this documentation.
